title: Instagram Carousel — the value is in the cabin (concept)
hook: Most people picture a private jet from the outside. The value is on the inside.
body:
You notice a jet from the ramp. You feel the difference in the four hours you spend inside it.

Stand-up cabin height, so you're not folding yourself into a seat. Quiet enough for a real conversation or a call. Room to work, eat, or sleep without negotiating for the space.

Cabins vary enormously between models. The right aircraft depends on how far you fly, how many people travel with you, and what you need to do onboard.

Tell us how you fly and we'll help you find the fit.
cta: Tell us how you fly and we'll help you find the fit.
media_notes: Concept post — NOT VJS inventory. Do not imply availability, price, or a tail number. Photos are illustrative of cabin experience only.
visual_headline: The value is on the inside.
visual_subline: Where you actually spend the most time.
notes: From Inbox item 'Luxury Cabin' (Kalene). Aspirational/education, not a listing. No prices, no tails, no 'available'. Warm-confident, no clichés or exclamation points.
